title.narrative: Value Chain Support Program for Tanzania's Cashew and Red Meat/Leather Industry

description.narrative: The 3ADI (Accelerated Agribusiness and Agro-industries Initiative) program is carried by a partnership between UNIDO, FAO and IFAD. It targets the expansion of agribusiness and agro-industries with a view of increasing food security by upgrading agricultural (subsistence) activities and transforming them into attractive and sophisticated agribusiness operations. UNIDO#s Value Chain Development Support Program aims to develop seminal pilot projects demonstrating how hygienic low-cost slaughtering facilities (with a capacity of around 100-150 cattle as well as 100-150 sheep and goats per day) can be set up and run successfully by applying a sustainable business model.
